title: #manandmoon #chicagotheater
transcript: last night I saw a beautiful new play called “Man and Moon” by Sienna Marilyn Ledger co presented by Dragonfly Theatre Company and the 16th Street Theater NFP it's a poetic lyrical 90 minute exploration of 2 lost souls who find each other in the most unexpected of places plot wise you can kind of see where it's going before it gets there but it's not really about the destination it's the journey direction by Hayley Procacci I hope I'm pronouncing their name right was perfectly paced the 2 very fine actors in this production are Clare Wols and Peter Danger Wilde peter's character Aaron is reluctant to make a connection and Luna - Clare’s character - just hurls herself towards them and I have to call out Clare who is a young performer who has so much to do in the show and she executes it beautifully plays thru November 13th at Madison Street Theater in Oak Park, Illinois
reasoning: Creator calls it a 'beautiful new play,' praises the pacing, direction, and both performances, with only a minor note about predictability that doesn't dampen the recommendation.
